originalProposals.reason: Calendar-year compression of Earth history is a standard geologic-time-scale teaching component for G9-E-6 (Precambrian duration). Only the history/timescale facet matches; eon/era/period does not. First-life-in-March is a common popularization of ~3.5–3.8 Ga on a 4.54 Ga scale (https://science.nasa.gov/earth/facts/). Translations OK.
